reasons: Missing-clause finding is substantiated: p0118 shows only Sparkling-side return/certification obligations on termination, and the survival list in p0131 contains no transition or data-return provision, so nothing in the cited text delivers exit assistance, data return, or deletion certification.

The inserted Section 17(d) tracks the preferred position closely (six months' assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable return within 30 days, then deletion plus written certification) and is placed in the termination section, with a correctly scoped, minimal conforming addition of '17(d)' to the survival list in p0131 (changed-character ratio 0.143).
Comment is accurate, in-house voice, cites the gap (we must return Garman's materials but get no exit help) and offers the 90-day fallback as directed by the playbook.

Minor, non-disqualifying deviation: data return is triggered 'within thirty (30) calendar days of Sparkling's request' rather than of termination, and the clause also sweeps in Confidential Information; both are acceptable (arguably beneficial) and do not undercut the playbook position.

Note for drafting review: the anchor paragraph p0129 is shown as 'not yet rendered', so the exact sub-section lettering/placement of the new (d) could not be visually confirmed, though the deterministic apply checks pass and the reference to 17(d) in the survival list is internally consistent.
